description:
About the Role

Adora's creative function serves 20+ customers and prospects, and behind every one of them sits a brand with its own visual language, creative direction principles, and aesthetic point of view. The Brand & Creative Direction Lead is accountable for making sure that point of view survives contact with AI production at scale, partnering directly with brand-side creative directors, translating their standards into Adora's AI tooling, and holding the final aesthetic bar on everything that reaches a client.

This is a senior individual contributor role. The Brand & Creative Direction Lead leads through taste and craft: staying close to flagship accounts, building real working relationships with the creative directors on the other side of the table, and setting the aesthetic bar the rest of the creative team works to. A Creative Ops Manager owns pipeline throughput and contractor management, freeing this role to focus on brand fidelity and the creative-director relationship.

lists.content:
Brand Aesthetic Standards

  • Hold the final aesthetic bar on all creative before it reaches a customer, asking whether it is actually on-brand, not just on-brief.

  • Lead the review and iteration cycle, weighing feedback from brand-side creative directors against Adora's own standards.

  • Translate each brand's visual identity and creative direction principles into standards Adora's AI tooling can consistently produce against.

  • Serve as the escalation point whenever a brand's aesthetic integrity is in question.

    • Creative Director Partnership

    • Serve as the direct creative counterpart to creative directors at Adora's flagship enterprise accounts, the person they call when something doesn't look right.

    • Build durable relationships with brand-side creative and creative direction teams across Adora's highest-profile partnerships.

    • Join customer meetings as the aesthetic and creative-direction point of contact, alongside Account Managers and leadership.

      • Customer Enablement & Brand Partnership

      • Lead onboarding for brand and creative direction teams adopting Adora, teaching them how to creative-direct through AI rather than around it.

      • Build enablement resources, including prompting guides, brand-specific style references, and worked examples, that let creative directors steward their own brand inside Adora's tooling.

        • Sales Enablement Creative

        • Produce sample creative for top-tier prospect brands that demonstrates range across aesthetics, not just output volume.

        • Partner with Sales on pitch creative, turning briefs around within sales cycle timelines.

        • Help define creative tiering for prospect and pitch requests.

          • Brand Playbooks & Prompting Systems

          • Turn each account's aesthetic standards into documented, repeatable prompting playbooks other people can execute against.

          • Set the creative brief standard the Creative Ops team briefs contractors against.

            • Product Feedback

            • Feed what you see across brands back to Product and Engineering: where the tooling helps creative direction translate cleanly, and where it doesn't.

• A track record in creative direction or brand stewardship for enterprise brands, whether agency, in-house, or studio, with real experience translating brand guidelines into executed work.

  • Strong aesthetic judgment across diverse brand identities, and the taste to know when something is technically correct but wrong for the brand.

  • Deep fluency with AI creative production, or a demonstrated ability to master a proprietary AI system quickly and turn it into standards other people can follow.

  • Real presence with senior client-side stakeholders, including creative directors and brand leads, with the ability to present creative, absorb feedback, and hold a point of view in the room.

  • Comfort with AI-native tools and technical workflows, including prompting and data-informed quality review.

  • Experience setting a standard for others' output and reviewing work against it.

• Formal design education, or a background as a brand designer or creative director.

  • Experience inside an AI-native or fast-scaling studio.

  • Light scripting or API familiarity.

• Creative on flagship accounts reads as unmistakably on-brand, with high creative-director satisfaction and low rework rates.

  • Brand playbooks and prompting standards are documented and adopted across the team without you in the loop on every piece.

  • Enterprise brand and creative direction teams can steward their own brand inside Adora's tooling using your enablement materials.

  • High-stakes pitch creative contributes directly to winning new enterprise accounts.

descriptionPlain:
Adora is building the next generation of AI-native marketing tools to help brands connect with customers in more intelligent, efficient, and effective ways. Backed by top-tier investors, we're at a pivotal moment of growth — and we're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager who can own client relationships and help shape what great customer success looks like at a company moving this quickly.
 
Role Overview
We're looking for a relationship manager with solid experience in enterprise accounts and the confidence to lead meaningful conversations with VP and CMO-level stakeholders. You'll manage a portfolio of clients, become a deep expert on the Adora platform, and serve as their trusted advisor — guiding them on how to leverage our technology to drive real marketing performance and business outcomes.
 
We are a startup. Some weeks you'll be leading a strategic business review with a senior marketing executive. Other weeks you'll be pulling reports, digging into performance data, and solving problems hands-on. If you're someone who rolls up their sleeves as naturally as you command a boardroom, this role is for you.
description:
Adora is building the next generation of AI-native marketing tools to help brands connect with customers in more intelligent, efficient, and effective ways. Backed by top-tier investors, we're at a pivotal moment of growth — and we're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager who can own client relationships and help shape what great customer success looks like at a company moving this quickly.
 
Role Overview
We're looking for a relationship manager with solid experience in enterprise accounts and the confidence to lead meaningful conversations with VP and CMO-level stakeholders. You'll manage a portfolio of clients, become a deep expert on the Adora platform, and serve as their trusted advisor — guiding them on how to leverage our technology to drive real marketing performance and business outcomes.
 
We are a startup. Some weeks you'll be leading a strategic business review with a senior marketing executive. Other weeks you'll be pulling reports, digging into performance data, and solving problems hands-on. If you're someone who rolls up their sleeves as naturally as you command a boardroom, this role is for you.

lists.content:
• Become a deep expert on the Adora platform and guide clients on how to leverage it effectively to improve marketing performance and business outcomes
  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisorLead executive business reviews and strategic planning sessions with VP and CMO-level stakeholders
  • Assist with renewals and account expansion — building growth through relationship and value, not hand-offs to sales
  • Monitor account health and proactively get ahead of risk before it becomes a problem
  • Get into the data when needed — pull and interpret performance reports, diagnose issues, and tell a clear story back to clients
  • Work cross-functionally with product and internal teams to advocate for client needs
  • Help build the playbooks, processes, and documentation that make the CS team more effective over time

• You've owned large enterprise relationships. You have 8+ years of experience in customer success or account management, with a track record of owning senior client relationships at scale. You've run executive-level meetings, navigated complex organizations, and been involved with retention and growth. You're the person clients trust — not because you're responsive, but because you're strategic.
  • You know the paid advertising world. You don't need to have spent years hands-on-keyboard in Meta or Google, but you understand how paid media works. You know the metrics, the levers, and how campaign performance connects to business outcomes. You're comfortable reading a performance report, asking the right questions, and translating results into a conversation a CMO cares about. And you're willing to dig in yourself when needed.
  • You're curious — especially about technology and AI. You don't wait for someone to tell you what tools to use or how to work smarter. You've been exploring AI tools on your own, building instincts, and finding ways to apply them — in your work and your life. You're not necessarily an expert, but you're clearly further along than most. More broadly, you have a pattern of finding better ways to do things rather than defaulting to what's always worked.
  • You're ready to operate without a big support structure. You've probably come from a larger company where you had SDRs, analysts, and specialists around you. That won't be the case here. You're comfortable being the senior person who also runs the dirty reports — and you don't think of that as beneath you. You want to be somewhere you can actually shape things.

• Experience in agency, AdTech, or martech environments
  • Prior startup or high-growth company experience (Series A–C)
  • Hands-on experience with Meta, Google, or other paid media platforms
  • Familiarity with AI tools and how they're being applied in marketing

• Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package
  • A collaborative, high-performance team in a high-growth startup
  • Opportunities for professional growth as the company scales
  • The chance to work at the forefront of AI-native marketing — and help define what that looks like for our clients

descriptionPlain:
Adora is an AI-native marketing technology platform helping enterprise organizations generate, launch, and optimize digital campaigns with greater control and visibility.
Headquartered in Seattle and New York, Adora brings creative assets, marketing data, and campaign performance signals together in a single system, enabling marketing teams to operate with greater scale, insight, and operational efficiency.
Adora has a growing roster of enterprise customers and continues to see strong demand from performance marketing organizations. As a result, we are expanding our sales team to support a rapidly growing pipeline of enterprise opportunities.
Role Overview
Adora is seeking an experienced enterprise seller based in New York to drive new business with leading brands. This role is ideal for someone excited about the impact of AI on the industry and who thrives in a fast-growing environment.
You will work directly with marketing leaders and teams at enterprise organizations. In this role, you will identify new opportunities, build customer relationships, and lead complex sales cycles while helping expand Adora’s presence in the market.
description:
Adora is an AI-native marketing technology platform helping enterprise organizations generate, launch, and optimize digital campaigns with greater control and visibility.

Headquartered in Seattle and New York, Adora brings creative assets, marketing data, and campaign performance signals together in a single system, enabling marketing teams to operate with greater scale, insight, and operational efficiency.

Adora has a growing roster of enterprise customers and continues to see strong demand from performance marketing organizations. As a result, we are expanding our sales team to support a rapidly growing pipeline of enterprise opportunities.

Role Overview

Adora is seeking an experienced enterprise seller based in New York to drive new business with leading brands. This role is ideal for someone excited about the impact of AI on the industry and who thrives in a fast-growing environment.

You will work directly with marketing leaders and teams at enterprise organizations. In this role, you will identify new opportunities, build customer relationships, and lead complex sales cycles while helping expand Adora’s presence in the market.

lists.content:
Enterprise Business Development:
Develop and close new business opportunities with leading brands, owning the full enterprise sales cycle from initial engagement through contract.

Strategic Sales Execution:
Lead complex sales processes for Adora’s AI platform, working across multiple stakeholders to establish new enterprise customers.

Executive Relationships:
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior marketing leaders, helping them evaluate how Adora can support their digital campaign strategy and performance goals.

Cross-Functional Leadership:
Work closely with product, marketing, and engineering teams to share market insights and ensure customer needs inform product development.

Industry Expertise:
Maintain a deep understanding of developments across digital advertising, performance marketing, and AI to effectively position Adora in a rapidly evolving market.

• A driven sales expert with 7+ years of experience in B2B software or SaaS sales, particularly targeting performance marketers.
  • Demonstrated success in high-value sales processes and customer relationship management.
  • Excited about AI technologies and their application in the digital advertising space.
  • Self-starter who thrives on building systems, nurturing client relationships, and exceeding sales targets.
  • Exceptional communicator, capable of explaining complex technology in an accessible manner.
  • A proactive contributor to a collaborative, startup environment.

• Competitive salary and commission structure.
  • Stock options and comprehensive benefits.
  • Opportunities for career growth in a fast-paced, innovative company.
  • A culture that values autonomy, creativity, and customer-centricity.

salaryDescription:
$120,000 – $160,000 base salary with on-target earnings (OTE) of $240,000 – $320,000 and uncapped commission.
In addition to the base salary above, this position is eligible for uncapped, role-specific commissions.

We are a rapidly growing Seattle & NYC SaaS company developing an innovative platform in a trillion-dollar industry. Adora is transforming how enterprise B2C brands take back control from platform algorithms. Our AI-powered performance marketing platform delivers Speed at Scale, enabling creative teams to outpace Meta and Google's changing requirements while driving measurable ROAS improvements.
 
We're seeking a Senior Fullstack Engineer who thinks in experiences, not features. You'll architect our customer-facing platform, understanding how marketers actually work and building the technical foundation that makes their jobs easier. This is a hands-on role where you'll code daily while shaping how our entire system evolves.
 
Tech stack: Python, MySQL, AWS, Big Query, React, TypeScript

lists.content:
• Build for real users: Spend time with customers, understand their workflows, and translate insights into holistic systems that scale, not just features that work
  • Own the full stack: Acting as an architect and builder for the user-facing application from front-end experiences to backend apis
  • Bridge the gap between our AI/ML systems and user-facing features, translating complex data pipelines into actionable interfaces
  • Build with speed and precision: rapidly prototype and iterate on new features while maintaining code quality and system reliability
  • Champion technical excellence: Share knowledge and establish patterns that make everyone more effective
  • Collaborate directly with product, design, and our founding team to shape the product roadmap

• 7+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years in fullstack roles, with strong frontend expertise and backend proficiency across:
  • Building and maintaining React web applications in TypeScript.
  • Architecting RESTful services and APIs and familiarity with database technologies (e.g., MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL).
  • Backend development using languages and frameworks such as Node.js, Python, Java, or Go.
  • Startup DNA: previous startup experience or genuine excitement about the startup environment - you thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving situations where you wear multiple hats.
  • Technical leadership: Proven ability to solve complex scalability challenges and design systems that can grow 10x without major rewrites.
  • Exceptional collaboration: thrive in cross-functional teams with low ego and high empathy. You proactively share progress, blockers, and insights ensuring the best product is built.

• Understanding of LLMs and how to integrate AI capabilities into user-facing products
  • Familiarity with marketing technology or advertising platforms / technology
  • Experience building B2B SaaS applications
